WITH filtered_processing AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    sp.memusagegb,
    sp.procgpu,
    sp.proccpu,
    s.entrystat
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8
),
per_site_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    entrystat,
    AVG(memusagegb) as avg_ram,
    AVG(CASE WHEN proccpu IS NOT NULL AND proccpu > 0 AND procgpu IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(procgpu AS FLOAT) / CAST(proccpu AS FLOAT)
            ELSE NULL END) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM filtered_processing
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
)
SELECT 
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) as avg_per_site_ram,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_per_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site_stats
GROUP BY entrystat
ORDER BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: "whose site code matches a site" means the zoneref value exists in the sites table (i.e., there is a row where sites.zoneregistry equals scanprocessing.zoneref)
When calculating GPU-to-CPU ratio, rows where proccpu is zero or NULL, or procgpu is NULL, are excluded from the ratio average (but included in RAM average if valid)

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude all rows with NULL or zero proccpu or NULL procgpu at the filtering stage, so both RAM and GPU/CPU ratio averages are computed only on rows with valid ratio values

WITH filtered_processing AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    sp.memusagegb,
    sp.procgpu,
    sp.proccpu,
    s.entrystat
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8
    AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.proccpu > 0
),
per_site_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    entrystat,
    AVG(memusagegb) as avg_ram,
    AVG(CAST(procgpu AS FLOAT) / CAST(proccpu AS FLOAT)) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM filtered_processing
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
)
SELECT 
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) as avg_per_site_ram,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_per_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site_stats
GROUP BY entrystat
ORDER BY entrystat
